A school close to home.

Supreme Public School stands near Adari Nadi and Chhat Ghat in Dumari, Baluganj. Children begin in Play group and continue up to Class VIII.

Start in Play group

Little learners join in Play group and grow into confident Class VIII students.

English medium

Lessons follow the CBSE pattern, taught in English.

Learning beyond the classroom

Students visit historic places with their teachers, so lessons come alive outside the textbook.

Prime Coaching Centre

Extra guidance is available at the Prime Coaching Centre in the same building.

Meet the principal.

Come to the school office to meet the principal, see the classrooms and ask about admission for your child.
